# Explore 200+ Construction classes + 5 customizable coverages


## Great Construction Relies on Creativity. So Does Great Coverage.


This National Construction Appreciation Week, we recognize the innovative brokers who find quality solutions no matter what challenges arise—the kind of brokers who turn to Kinsale’s[Construction Division](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/casualty/construction/) for answers.


With an appetite for[more than 200 construction classes,](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/casualty/construction/#target-classes) Kinsale can consider everything from straightforward accounts to risks that fall outside standard-market parameters.


---


### **Choose from five customizable coverage options:**


- **General Liability** – Commercial, industrial & residential trade contractors
- **Project-Specific & Owner’s Interest –** Coverage built around a single job, start to finish
- **OCP –** Owners & Contractors Protective Liability
- **Discontinued Operations –** For businesses being sold or closing operations
- **Railroad GL & Protective Liability –** Specialized coverages for railroads & railroad-adjacent contractors


---


**At Kinsale, we know insurance solutions, like construction projects, are only as good as the craftsmanship behind them.** That’s why our underwriters personally read every submission, pick up the phone to answer your questions, and apply creativity and experience to create quotes that work for you and your accounts.


**Submit your risk today. We’ll work with you to build the solution.**
